invariants.contract: GET /api/libraries/:id/stats of the fixture book library answers the five items by size and by duration with id, title and size or duration, the authors with book counts, the genres with counts, and the totals of items, size, duration and audio tracks.
GET stats of a podcast library omits totalAuthors and authorsWithCount and reports the podcast's genre, size, duration and episode count as audio tracks.

In a library of twelve books by twelve authors the largest items, longest items and authors with count are cut to ten, the largest are the ten biggest by size in descending order, totals cover all twelve, and genres are ordered by count.
GET stats of a library without items answers empty lists and zero totals for books.

GET stats answers 401 without a token, 403 for a user without access to the library (before existence is checked), 404 for an unknown id, and 400 for an invalid limit; any user with library access may read it.
